## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] Tested on iOS and Android (screenshots below for UI changes)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or PII in code or logs
- [ ] New tables have RLS + owner policy (if applicable)
- [ ] User-facing text goes through `t()`; tokens only (no raw colors/sizes)
- [ ] Shared docs updated if a decision, command or rule changed (ADRs, `docs/SETUP.md`, `AGENTS.md`)
